objective: Reduce a direct automatic-FAIL risk from visible primitive-placeholder geometry by replacing the legacy RainGutter cylinder fallback with an authored physical vertical rainwater downpipe assembly while preserving Godot and existing mature Danchi systems.

observedSourceIssue.finding: The generated Danchi fallback creates five visible RainGutter objects from Unity PrimitiveType.Cylinder. This is a direct source-level risk for the critical defect visible_primitive_placeholder_geometry if the legacy renderers reach formal benchmark framing.
observedSourceIssue.response: Keep the legacy objects only as disabled provenance and author a dedicated DanchiRainwaterDrainage LOD assembly from QualityBlockDetailMeshLibrary meshes.

materials.pvc: dielectric aged PVC, metallic 0, smoothness 0.32-0.42, 512-square generated normal and metallic/smoothness physical-data textures, dry benchmark wetness 0
materials.highlightPolicy: No highlight direction is baked into albedo/normal/roughness. Specular response must come from the coherent scene sun, sky and reflection state.

implementation.weathering: Cause-based baseline only: ordinary exterior UV chalking and sheltered hardware dust retention. No arbitrary damage or story-driven masks.
implementation.formalRenderBehavior: QA4K/QATemporal/QAPreparedTemporal and Reflection-camera pre-cull validation is read-only and fail-closed; it does not repair the assembly during evidence generation.

implementationReadiness.reason: Source/data/QA implementation advanced, but real Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime evidence remains unavailable. No readiness points are awarded speculatively.
